name: Monitor Pressing
implementation_notes: pressing_record/pressing_detail local SQLite tables in localSchema.ts unchanged by this revision (same columns/unique constraint) -- only the row-population pattern changed
pressingRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Pressing screens (038/042/046) in one file, same convention as threshingRecordRepo.ts covering screens 037/041/045

REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, correcting the original design the user explicitly rejected): createDraft() now inserts ONLY the header row -- the 24 pre-created pressing_detail rows were a literal reading of the paper log-sheet mockup that wasted screen space; rows are now added one at a time by the user in Form Pressing via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring threshingRecordRepo.ts's just-fixed pattern (itself mirroring cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts's cages_tipped_time pattern)

'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Tercatat' counter redefined as a plain COUNT(*) of pressing_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no longer filtered by 'has >=1 reading column filled', since row existence itself is now the meaningful signal (a row only exists because the user explicitly added it); MonitorPressingView.vue's counter field renamed from filledSlotCount/counter-filled-slot-count to detailRowCount/counter-detail-row-count
Router: route name 'monitor-pressing' registered in router/index.ts, but StationListView.vue (screen-006, explicitly out of this task's scope) has NOT been updated to link to it -- see known_issues
